critique: The river metaphor is elegantly executed through the fluid visual representation of time as a continuous blue stream, but the interaction model contradicts this naturalistic flow by imposing rigid meeting blocks that slice through rather than bridge across the temporal current. While the color system effectively distinguishes occupied versus available time, the stark rectangular geometry of the meetings creates visual tension that undermines the organic promise of 'time flowing like water'—the structural relationships feel more like dams than bridges.
